verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents automated evidence collection via integrations (AWS, GitHub, Google Workspace) that continuously monitor resources, plus a dedicated 'Fieldwork' feature where 'AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule,' directly replacing manual screenshots/CSV with scheduled machine-gathered artifacts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of scheduling cadence and timestamping specifics, and no first-party detail on artifact storage/immutability guarantees.
